method.title: Mars: terrain proxies from HiRISE
paragraphs: Five HiRISE sites, each an orthoimage strip with its digital terrain model, are cut into 15,233 coverage-eligible patches at 2 m per pixel.

Each patch has three terrain proxy targets taken from the terrain model: 5 m mean slope in degrees, roughness in metres and hazard fraction. A patch counts as safe, a derived proxy label, when its mean slope is under 8 degrees and its hazard fraction is under 0.05. It is not an observed landing outcome.

method.title: Mars: the two models
paragraphs: The CNN is a ResNet-18 trained end to end from random initialisation, with 11,242,563 trainable parameters.

The hybrid keeps that trained CNN representation frozen and fits an 8-dimensional bottleneck and an 8-qubit QCNN head on it, 4,152 trainable parameters in all. The comparison is between two pipelines, not two architectures of equal capacity.

method.title: Mars: how it was tested
paragraphs: Leave one site out: in each of five folds, three sites train, one validates and one is the test site. Every fold was run with seeds 42, 43 and 44.
Safe decisions are scored two ways: at the fixed proxy thresholds, and at a risk threshold chosen on the validation site so that its false-positive rate is at most 5%, then applied to the test site.

method.title: Moon: crater classes from LROCNet
paragraphs: LROCNet crops from the LRO Narrow Angle Camera are labelled ejecta, old crater or none. The supplied split has 3,608 training, 613 validation and 779 test crops. The test set is 68.4% none, so balanced accuracy and macro-F1 are reported alongside accuracy.

method.title: Moon: three models
paragraphs: The CNN is trained end to end, with 59,347 trainable parameters. The hybrid QCNN head (568 trainable parameters) and a frozen-embedding MLP control (547) are both trained on the CNN's frozen embeddings, so the MLP is the matched classical comparison for the quantum head.
The reported results come from 10 deterministic seeds, 42 to 51, which supersede an earlier three-seed run whose head initialisation could not be reproduced.

method.title: Quantum circuits were simulated
paragraphs: Every quantum circuit ran on a classical simulator (PennyLane default.qubit). Nothing here ran on quantum hardware, and no quantum advantage is claimed.

method.title: What this site shows
paragraphs: Every figure, prediction and label on this site comes from saved experiment outputs. Nothing is retrained or recomputed in the browser, and the numbers match the project's readiness audit.
